title: G3 · 接受
body: Changed two functions: `matMul` now uses i-j-k with a pre-transposed `bt[j*n+k] = b[k*n+j]` and an 8× unrolled inner k-loop (so `c[i,j]` lives in a register for the full k-sweep, `a[i,:]` is reused in L1 across all `j`, and `bt[j,:]` is walked sequentially), and `primesUpTo` now uses an odd-only sieve (`sieve[i] ↔ 2i+3`) that halves both the sieve footprint and the inner marking loop. All other six exports are byte-for-byte identical to gen 1. Projected holdout geomean: 27.4× → ~29.5×, clearing the 28.7× bar with ~3% margin even under conservative estimates for both levers.
